snippet.title: How Many Dudes? - Official Launch Trailer - Roguelike Strategy Autobattler
snippet.description:
This is our new game How Many Dudes - you can play the Demo for free on Steam right now, and buy it on all the platforms below when it releases on July 30th 2026! 
👇👇👇
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3934270
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.bscotch.hmd&hl=en-US
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/how-many-dudes/id6753077755

How Many Dudes is an autobattler roguelike, like a weird blend of Balatro, Slay the Spire, and Totally Accurate Battle Simulator. You run a dude ranch where you collect an army of dudes, create synergies with relics, and use all that dudepower to break the game.

We're trying to cover all those big questions, like:
- How many dudes does it take to defeat a gorilla?
- How many dudes does it take to defeat a horse-sized duck? or 100 duck-sized horses?
- How many dudes does it take to defeat 1000 toddlers?

Join the discord to share your best dude combos and see how far you can get! https://discord.com/invite/bscotch
